decisions.reason: A wood floor cleaning soap fits the firm's existing knowledge of wood surfaces and complements its parquet range, so the firm can read customer feedback and refine the product easily.
A maintenance oil for wooden floors draws directly on the firm's know-how in wood finishing and supports sales of oiled floors, which gives it high relatedness and low risk.
This care product for oiled floors builds on related knowledge, but it overlaps with the maintenance oil, so there is a modest chance the firm consolidates its care range.

A moisture-protection underlay is an accessory sold alongside flooring that the firm can interpret through installation feedback, although it relies on foam and film technology outside its core wood competence.

A high density foam underlay is further from the firm's wood expertise and is probably sourced from suppliers, so it is somewhat more likely to be streamlined, but it still supports the floor system offer.
Oak parquet is the firm's core wood competence, where its absorptive capacity is highest, so it will very likely remain on the market.
